HomeLocationsMai Khao

Mai Khao is Phuket's longest and most natural beach, stretching along the north-west coast inside Sirinat National Park. It is home to large resorts and a few residential projects, with the airport at its southern end.

About Mai Khao

Mai Khao is the northernmost of the areas in our catalogue, on Phuket's north-west coast in Thalang district, beyond Nai Yang. We list two projects here: a condominium (Maviston Mai Khao) and a private pool villa development near Mai Khao Beach.

Our project data has no distances for this area yet, so ask us for travel times to the beach and the airport.

Why buyers choose Mai Khao

  • Phuket's longest beach
  • Protected sea-turtle nesting area
  • Close to the airport
  • Resort-style, very quiet surroundings

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Nai Yang

Lifestyle and amenities

Mai Khao is very quiet, with resort restaurants, a small local village and the Turtle Village shopping area. Most daily needs are a drive away.

Beaches and surroundings

Mai Khao Beach runs for many kilometres with few buildings. Its southern end is famous for planes landing just overhead. The beach is a nesting site for sea turtles, and waves can be strong during the monsoon.

Rental demand in Mai Khao

Rentals in Mai Khao are mostly resort-managed holiday stays. The market is small and focused on guests who want a quiet, natural beach.

Short-term holiday rentals

Resort and condotel units let to holiday guests, mainly in the dry season.

Long-term rentals

Limited, because daily amenities are far away.

Suitable property types

Resort-managed condos and villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: unique, uncrowded beach. Limitations: few services, distance to the rest of the island and a small tenant pool.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Mai Khao

Mai Khao suits buyers who prioritise nature and privacy, often with resort management. Rental income is typically seasonal and depends on the operator.

Typical investor profiles

Holiday-home owners using resort management.

Risks to consider

Small market, reliance on the resort operator and national park restrictions.

Ownership costs

Resort fees, management commission and maintenance.

Mai Khao: frequently asked questions

Is Mai Khao the longest beach in Phuket?

Yes, Mai Khao is generally described as Phuket's longest beach, running along the north-west coast inside Sirinat National Park.

Can you watch planes at Mai Khao Beach?

Yes, the southern end of the beach is close to the runway and planes land just overhead.

Is Mai Khao good for swimming?

In the dry season, yes; from about May to October the waves and currents can be strong.

How far is Mai Khao from the airport?

Our project data gives about 10 to 17 km to Phuket International Airport.

Are there shops and restaurants in Mai Khao?

There are resort restaurants and the Turtle Village shopping area, but larger amenities are a drive away.

How much does property in Mai Khao cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Mai Khao run from ฿9,300,000 to ฿26,000,000 (2 of 2 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
